title: Launch host provisioning
summary: The isolated staging host is provisioned in the approved region at the approved capacity and hardened baseline.
evidence: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS runs with four virtual CPUs, eight GiB RAM, and 160 GiB SSD storage.
SSH uses dedicated keys while root, password, and keyboard-interactive login are disabled.
The firewall denies inbound traffic by default and exposes only SSH.
The loopback-only staging application passed health and access-control smoke checks.
limitations: Production cutover, public ingress, and DNS changes require separate approval.
